chunks: 260 - The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day"

then he should not leave the hair of his pubic region for more than forty days; and it is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to leave that from herself for more than twenty days.

key_terms.أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْمًا: forty days; the maximum period mentioned for men
key_terms.عِشْرِينَ يَوْمًا: twenty days; the maximum period mentioned for women
key_terms.يُؤْمِنُ: believes; denotes faith and moral commitment
key_terms.ٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْآخِرِ: the Last Day; the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about how long pubic hair may be left untrimmed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling on personal cleanliness, linking grooming of the pubic region to faith in Allah and the Last Day. It sets a maximum period of forty days for men and twenty days for women, emphasizing bodily cleanliness and proper etiquette.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.260 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever believes in Allah (swt) and the Last Day (Qiyamah)

should not leave the hair of their pubic region untrimmed for more than forty days, and it is not permissible for a woman who believes in Allah (swt) and the Last Day (Qiyamah) to leave it untrimmed for more than twenty days."
